content.text: The atlas tools were denied, so I'll search the files directly.

The component is defined in `components/public/restock-alert-modal.tsx`, which exports `RestockAlertModal` and `RestockAlertModalProps`. The atlas tools were permission-denied, so I used a text search, and the list comes from that.

Five files import and render it:
- `app/(public)/page.tsx` imports it with `next/dynamic` (lazy-loaded) and renders it around line 664. It also does a type-only import of `RestockAlertModalProps`.
- `app/portal/reseller/catalog/page.tsx` imports it (line 23) and renders it around line 834.
- `components/dev-studio/tabs/VendingCheckoutTab.tsx` imports it (line 23) and renders it around line 407.
- `components/dev-studio/tabs/VaultAndModalsTab.tsx` imports it (line 18) and renders it around line 177.
- `components/dev-studio/tabs/ModalLauncherTab.tsx` imports it (line 16) and renders it around line 165.

The modal posts to `app/api/public/restock-alert/route.ts`, but that file doesn't import the component. `components/navigation/overlay-layers.ts` mentions the restock alert only in a comment. `ButtonSandboxTab.tsx` only has a "Restock Alert" button label.

My search was case-insensitive on `restock.?alert` in ts/tsx/js/jsx/vue/svelte files, capped at 50 results. It showed every file that mentions the modal, but I didn't re-run it uncapped. A re-export or barrel file that uses a different name could have been missed.
